title: How much / How many
grammarTitle: How much / How many — считаем и спрашиваем о количестве
grammarNote:
"How much" и "How many" — оба переводятся как "Сколько?", но используются с РАЗНЫМИ типами существительных. Ключевой вопрос: это существительное ИСЧИСЛЯЕМОЕ или НЕИСЧИСЛЯЕМОЕ?

🔢 ИСЧИСЛЯЕМЫЕ (Countable) — можно посчитать поштучно:
   1 apple, 2 apples, 3 apples... → "How MANY apples?"
   1 baursak, 5 baursaks... → "How MANY baursaks?"
   1 student, 20 students... → "How MANY students?"

💧 НЕИСЧИСЛЯЕМЫЕ (Uncountable) — нельзя посчитать поштучно:
   water, rice, soup, bread, milk, tea, money, time, food...
   → Нельзя сказать "1 water, 2 waters"!
   → "How MUCH water?" · "How MUCH rice?" · "How MUCH money?"

⚠️ Главное правило:
HOW MANY + существительное во МНОЖЕСТВЕННОМ числе (apples, eggs, students)
HOW MUCH + существительное БЕЗ множественного числа (water, rice, bread)

Отвечаем на "How much / many?":
a lot of · much · many · a few · a little · not much · not many · none

grammarTable.subject: Countable nouns (можно посчитать)
grammarTable.example: How many apples? · How many eggs? · How many baursaks? · How many students?

grammarTable.subject: Uncountable nouns (нельзя посчитать)
grammarTable.example: How much water? · How much rice? · How much soup? · How much money?

rows.example: an apple → apples · an egg → eggs · a baursak → baursaks · a grape → grapes
one apple, two apples · a baursak, three baursaks · an orange, five oranges
"How many apples do you want?" · "How many eggs are in the fridge?" · "How many portions?"
"Many / A lot of / A few / Not many / None" + noun → "A few apples." · "Not many eggs."

rows.form: Примеры из столовой ЗКУ им. М. Утемісова:
rows.example: How many baursaks? · How many salads? · How many portions? · How many students are in the queue?
❌ "waters" / "rices" / "soups" / "breads" — неправильно! (в большинстве случаев)

rows.form: Перед ними: some/any, a glass of, a cup of...
rows.example: "some water" · "a glass of juice" · "a cup of tea" · "a bowl of soup" · "a loaf of bread"
"How much water do you drink?" · "How much rice is in the dish?" · "How much tea do you want?"
"Much / A lot of / A little / Not much / None" → "A little water." · "Not much rice."

rows.form: Самые частые uncountable в теме еды:
rows.example: water · milk · tea · coffee · juice · rice · bread · soup · meat · fish · sugar · salt · oil · butter · flour

grammarExtra.title: Ответы на How much? и How many? — a lot of / much / many / a few / a little

rows.example: "I drink a lot of water." · "There are a lot of students." — универсально!
"I have many apples." · "How many students are there?" — для исчисляемых.
"I don't drink much coffee." · "How much sugar?" — для неисчисляемых.
"I have a few apples." (3-4) · "There are a few options." — небольшое количество.
"I have a little water." · "Add a little salt." — небольшое количество.
"There isn't much bread left." · "There aren't many vegetarian options."

grammarExtra.title: В столовой ЗКУ им. М. Утемісова — практические примеры

rows.form: "How much soup do you want?" → "A bowl, please."
rows.example: soup = uncountable → How MUCH. Ответ с контейнером: a bowl of soup.

rows.form: "How many baursaks are there?" → "A lot! Take some."
rows.example: baursaks = countable → How MANY.

rows.form: "How much does the lunch cost?" → "600 tenge."
rows.example: money = uncountable → How MUCH. (Сколько стоит? = How much is it?)
calories = countable → How MANY.

rows.form: "How much rice comes with the main course?"
rows.example: rice = uncountable → How MUCH.

rows.form: "How many glasses of water do you drink per day?"
rows.example: glasses = countable → How MANY. Но water само по себе — uncountable!

grammarTip:
Секрет How much / How many — один вопрос:
"Могу ли я сказать ONE ___, TWO ___s?"

✅ Можно посчитать → How MANY?
   one apple, two apples → How MANY apples?
   one baursak, five baursaks → How MANY baursaks?

❌ Нельзя посчитать → How MUCH?
   one water? ❌ → How MUCH water?
   one rice? ❌ → How MUCH rice?
   one money? ❌ → How MUCH money?

💡 Универсальные ответы:
a lot of = много (работает с обоими!)
a few = немного штук (только countable)
a little = немного вещества (только uncountable)

🍽️ Запомни самые частые uncountable в теме еды:
water · milk · tea · coffee · rice · bread · soup · meat · sugar · salt
→ Всегда How MUCH, никогда How MANY!

exercises.instruction: Choose How much or How many.
exercises.text: ___ water do you drink every day, Ruslan?
exercises.hint: Water = uncountable (cannot say "1 water, 2 waters") → How MUCH water.

exercises.instruction: Choose How much or How many.
exercises.text: ___ baursaks are there on the table today?
exercises.hint: Baursaks = countable (1 baursak, 2 baursaks) → How MANY baursaks.

exercises.text: "How many rice do you want?" is correct English.
exercises.hint: Rice = uncountable → "How MUCH rice do you want?" You cannot say "1 rice, 2 rices".

exercises.instruction: Write How much or How many.
exercises.text: ___ does the lunch cost at the WKU cafeteria? — Only 600 tenge!
exercises.hint: Money/price = uncountable → How MUCH does it cost? (Сколько стоит?)
Soup is uncountable → answer with "a little" (not "a few" which is for countable).

exercises.text: "How many students are in the queue?" — ___
exercises.hint: Students = countable → answer with "a lot of students" or "many students".

exercises.instruction: Write How much or How many.
exercises.text: ___ eggs do you want in your omelette? — Two, please.
exercises.hint: Eggs = countable (1 egg, 2 eggs, 3 eggs) → How MANY eggs.

opts: How many money do you have?
How much apples are on the table?
How many portions of rice do you want?
How much students eat in the cafeteria?
exercises.correct: How many portions of rice do you want?
exercises.hint: "Portions" = countable → How MANY portions. Others: money/rice/students — wrong choice of much/many.
